- **Hover to previe"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"w** — hover the rail and the panel slides out with each question's
opening words (single-line trunca"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ted), `#turn` badge and `HH:MM` time. Collapses 240 ms
after you move away. Pure overlay — your cont"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ent never shifts.
- **Click to open as well** — clicking the strip (or a bar) pins the panel open un"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"til you
close it with `Esc`, the ×, or a click outside, so the rail also works on touch, pen and
aut"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"omation where no hover event ever arrives.
- **Click-to-jump** — switches to the Chat view (even fro"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"m Trajectory), scrolls to the
message and flashes it for 1.8 s. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`; a"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" jump that cannot
reach the message reports it in the panel instead of failing silently.
- **Search "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"& load older** — case-insensitive filtering, plus paging into older history.
- **Live** — new questi"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ons appear while the session runs; follows the current session and
collapses on switch.
- **Zero dep"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"endencies at runtime** — the browser bundle imports only React (the platform
